coppe-08.exo: Emotional tiredness, disinterest, abandoning what no longer nourishes. It points to the end of an emotional cycle and the need to look elsewhere for new sap.
coppe-08.psy: The exhaustion of someone who has given too much to something that gives nothing back; the apathy that signals a deep need for change rather than a fault.
coppe-08.ini: Water in Hod, intellectual Splendour, with Saturn in Pisces in the first decan: the waters lose their current under Saturn's weight and their warmth goes out. Indolence is emotion that no longer flows, feeling turned to marsh.
coppe-08.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals depression, inertia, abandonment of responsibilities, resignation.
coppe-08.up: Something has run out: acknowledge it and withdraw your energies to invest them where there is life.
coppe-08.rev: Tiredness denied, an obstinacy to stay where you are no longer nourished; or a first return of interest and vitality.
coppe-08.love: Emotional detachment, a relationship gone flat; a need to ask honestly what remains.
coppe-08.work: Demotivation, stalled projects, a wish to change field or pace.
coppe-08.spirit: Detachment as a necessary passage toward deeper springs.
coppe-08.crowley: In the Thoth deck eight low, cracked cups collect a few drops from withered lotuses, above a murky, motionless sea: stagnation under a leaden sky.

coppe-09.exo: Happiness, satisfaction, desires realised. It points to health, serenity, emotional and material success: traditionally it is the card of the wish fulfilled.
coppe-09.psy: The joy of emotional fulfilment lived without guilt; the ability to feel content and to let this fullness radiate onto others.
coppe-09.ini: Water in Yesod, the Foundation, with Jupiter in Pisces, his own house, in the second decan: the great benefic spreads the waters into a stable base. Happiness is emotion restored to balance after the trials of Netzach and Hod.
coppe-09.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals vanity, complacency, selfish satisfaction that ignores others.
coppe-09.up: Your wishes find an answer: enjoy the happiness with gratitude and share it.
coppe-09.rev: Happiness that is only a facade or depends on outside conditions; dissatisfaction hidden beneath appearances.
coppe-09.love: Serenity as a couple, shared wishes fulfilled, generous affection.
coppe-09.work: Satisfaction, results achieved, recognition and financial stability.
coppe-09.spirit: Gratitude as a spiritual act that multiplies joy.
coppe-09.crowley: In the Thoth deck nine cups arranged in a perfect square overflow with water poured from lotuses: happiness full, ordered and stable.

coppe-10.exo: Emotional fullness, completion, emotional success. It points to the culmination of a happiness which, precisely because it is complete, prepares a change.
coppe-10.psy: Fullness that risks becoming satiety: having everything you wanted can generate a new emptiness. It asks you to cultivate gratitude without clinging.
coppe-10.ini: Water in Malkuth, with Mars in Pisces in the third decan: Martial fire disturbs the perfection of the waters. Satiety is completion that carries the seed of rupture, because what is full can only overflow.
coppe-10.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals boredom, excess, waste, the squandering of what you have obtained.
coppe-10.up: Fullness and completion: enjoy the result, but prepare wisely for the next cycle.
coppe-10.rev: Satiety, dissatisfaction, a wish for change; or difficulty recognising how much you already have.
coppe-10.love: Family harmony, affections fulfilled; beware of routine that puts out desire.
coppe-10.work: The culmination of a project, full success; it is time to think about renewal.
coppe-10.spirit: Completion as opening: the full cup must be offered in order to be filled again.
coppe-10.crowley: Crowley arranges ten cups on the Tree of Life, dominated by red tones; the highest cup tips, showing that fullness is about to spill.

coppe-cavaliere.exo: A romantic, gentle and dreamy person, or the arrival of an emotional or artistic proposal. It points to invitations, declarations, idealistic enthusiasms.
coppe-cavaliere.psy: The side of the personality moved by ideals and feelings: enthusiastic and generous but not very constant, more in love with the image of love than with its daily effort.
coppe-cavaliere.ini: Fire of Water, the Yod of He, referred to Chokmah: the impetus that sets the waters in motion, like rain and springs. He rules from 21° Aquarius to 20° Pisces, joining vision and compassion.
coppe-cavaliere.sha: Ill-dignified, he is lazy, sensual, not very sincere, inconstant.
coppe-cavaliere.up: Accept the invitation or the inspiration: the feeling asks to be expressed.
coppe-cavaliere.rev: Disappointed idealism, promises not kept, unstable emotionality.
coppe-cavaliere.love: A romantic suitor, emotional proposals, declarations.
coppe-cavaliere.work: Creative or artistic proposals, projects inspired by ideals.
coppe-cavaliere.spirit: The Grail knight following an ideal of beauty.
coppe-cavaliere.crowley: Crowley portrays a winged knight on a white horse surging forward, holding a cup from which a crab emerges, with a peacock beside him: the sensitive grace of water in motion.

coppe-regina.exo: A sensitive, intuitive and welcoming person, or the ability to mirror and understand others. It points to listening, empathy, artistic or mediumistic gifts.
coppe-regina.psy: The psyche as a mirror: it reflects what is presented to it faithfully, but risks losing its own outlines.
coppe-regina.ini: Water of Water, the He of He, referred to Binah: pure receptivity, water that reflects without holding. She rules from 21° Gemini to 20° Cancer, where the mind becomes feeling.
coppe-regina.sha: Ill-dignified, she is dependent, easily influenced, lost in fantasies, unable to tell her own feelings from those of others.
coppe-regina.up: Listen to your sensitivity and use it to understand: the answer lies in the reflected emotions.
coppe-regina.rev: Emotional confusion, weak boundaries, excess of sensitivity or fantasy.
coppe-regina.love: A sweet, intuitive partner; a deep love that asks for protection.
coppe-regina.work: Caring roles, counselling, art; the ability to understand the needs of others.
coppe-regina.spirit: The purity of the mirror that reflects divine light without distorting it.
coppe-regina.crowley: The Queen of the Thoth deck is almost invisible, wrapped in veils of light and reflected in motionless waters, with an ibis and a lotus: pure receptivity, a perfect mirror.

coppe-principe.exo: A passionate but reserved person, gifted with artistic talent, with volcanic emotions beneath a calm, controlled appearance; or an intense, undeclared emotional situation.
coppe-principe.psy: The intelligence born of emotion: the ability to turn feelings into art and strategy, but also a tendency to hide what you feel and to use it as power.
coppe-principe.ini: Air of Water, the Vau of He, referred to Tiphareth: the vapour rising from the waters. He rules from 21° Libra to 20° Scorpio, between Venusian harmony and Scorpionic intensity.
coppe-principe.sha: Ill-dignified, he is ruthless, manipulative, calculating, able to wound without scruple.
coppe-principe.up: Your deep emotions are a creative force: express them sincerely instead of keeping them under control.
coppe-principe.rev: Hidden emotions that turn into manipulation; secrets, jealousy, coldness.
coppe-principe.love: Deep but little-expressed passion; an intense and mysterious lover.
coppe-principe.work: Creativity, strategy, the ability to read other people's emotions.
coppe-principe.spirit: Turning passion into awareness, like water becoming vapour and rising.
coppe-principe.crowley: The Prince of Cups drives a chariot drawn by an eagle across placid waters, holding a lotus and a cup from which a serpent emerges: power hidden beneath calm.

coppe-principessa.astro: Celestial quadrant of Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius; throne of the Ace
coppe-principessa.exo: A sweet, dreamy and gentle young person, or a new emotional or creative beginning that arises in silence. It points to affectionate messages, fantasy, artistic sensitivity and at times mediumistic intuitions.
coppe-principessa.psy: The tender, imaginative part of yourself, able to dream and to be moved; a rich inner world that asks to be protected and, at the same time, to express itself.
coppe-principessa.ini: Earth of Water, the final He of He, referred to Malkuth: water that crystallises and takes form. Throne of the Ace of Cups, she rules the celestial quadrant of Libra, Scorpio and Sagittarius, where the Mother's receptivity becomes body and image.
coppe-principessa.sha: Ill-dignified, she is selfish, lazy, capricious, shut into fantasies that estrange her from others.
coppe-principessa.up: Welcome the dreams and messages of the unconscious: nourish your sensitivity and give it a creative form.
coppe-principessa.rev: Emotional immaturity, misplaced fantasies, laziness; or sensitivity stifled for fear of judgement.
coppe-principessa.love: Tenderness, sincere affection, a young love or a gentler way of loving.
coppe-principessa.work: Creativity, new ideas, artistic or caring work; a talent still to be grown.
coppe-principessa.spirit: Sweetness as the door of grace and sacred imagination.
coppe-principessa.crowley: In the Thoth deck the Princess dances among the waves, with a swan crown, a dolphin and a shell from which a turtle emerges: the fantasy and sweetness of water incarnate.
